description: Open-source model catalogue (F23). The repository holds this manifest only, never the weights - entries list where to get them and where they land. 'id' for image_engine entries matches the engine id in backend/app/engines.py so download status can be cross-checked against what ComfyUI actually has loaded.

models.description: Fast 4-step image model. Requires a free huggingface.co account and accepting the licence; no negative-prompt input so it can't be steered away from anatomy issues.
models.download_hint: hf download black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell flux1-schnell.safetensors ae.safetensors --local-dir comfyui/models (then move into unet/ and vae/); hf download comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders clip_l.safetensors t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors --local-dir comfyui/models/clip

models.license: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M (Stability AI) + AGPL-3.0 (Impact Pack/ADetailer)
models.description: SDXL base checkpoint plus an automatic face/hand detection and inpaint pass. The strongest engine for fixing contorted anatomy.
models.download_hint: hf download stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors --local-dir comfyui/models/checkpoints; hf download Bingsu/adetailer face_yolov8m.pt hand_yolov8n.pt --local-dir comfyui/models/ultralytics/bbox

models.description: Sharpest detail and best in-image text rendering, at the cost of the slowest generation time even with its 4-step Lightning LoRA. No account required.
models.download_hint: hf download Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI split_files/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2512_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors --local-dir comfyui/models (then move each into diffusion_models/, text_encoders/, vae/); hf download lightx2v/Qwen-Image-2512-Lightning Qwen-Image-2512-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-fp32.safetensors --local-dir comfyui/models/loras
